title: [dynamo] Show recompilation reason when set_stance("fail_on_recompile") fails
bug_description:
Today, even with `TORCH_LOGS=recompiles`, `set_stance("fail_on_recompile")` failures do not provide the reason why the recompilation occurred, e.g.

```
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch2/torch/_dynamo/eval_frame.py", line 251, in fail_callback
    raise RuntimeError(message)
RuntimeError: Detected recompile when torch.compile stance is 'fail_on_recompile'. filename: '/data/users/williamwen/pytorch2/torch/_dynamo/external_utils.py', function name: 'inner', line number: 66
```

We should show the recompilation reason normally logged to `TORCH_LOGS=recompiles`, similar to when the recompilation limit is hit.
